mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 2% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS shows a 3-month increase and 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases by more than 0.5% and 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in Industrial Production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals supply-side weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines by more than 1% and 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the CPI (CPIAUCSL) is rising, the combination signals a tightening monetary policy environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS is above 4% and CPIAUCSL is rising, but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 100,000 in one month, combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3%, signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS declines by more than 100k and UNRATE increases by more than 0.3%, but 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in one month signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases by more than 10% and 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) by more than 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 declines by more than 0.5% QoQ during a tightening cycle, but 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the triggered instances.
